# Another day, another browser
After my dalliance with the Ecosia browser back in August, I eventually uninstalled it as I was having some problems on sites I visited regularly.

I went back to Brave and thought nothing more about it.

A couple of days ago my attention was drawn to a new offering - bare browser - yet another Chromium based browser designed for simplicity and privacy.

It's early days (and I have a few niggles here and there) but it looks promising.

Definitely one to watch.
